summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of cipher-box end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format, server-side migration infrastructure, Rust desktop support, and web client login flow with lazy migration.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully executed and verified (4/4 plans, 6/6 requirements). Multiple UAT bugs found and fixed during checkpoint verification. PR #344 created, merge conflicts resolved, and PR review comments addressed.

repo: orval v7.18.0 generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields in OpenAPI spec — confirmed bug, `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround
NestJS does not auto-log incoming request routes, making it appear endpoints are never called when they actually are — always verify via DB query when API logs show nothing

Kubo API port 5001 does not send CORS headers, blocking all browser requests; IPFS gateway port 8080 has `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and supports IPNS resolution via `/ipns/{name}` HEAD request returning `X-Ipfs-Roots` CID header

IPNS records published during development are not propagated to the public DHT — subfolder IPNS records only exist in the CipherBox API DB cache and require JWT auth to access, making them unavailable to the unauthenticated recovery tool
The IPNS controller is fully JWT-guarded — no public endpoint exists for recovery tool use
Zustand stores are not exposed on `window` by default in this project

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes — did not detect v2 binary format before parsing, causing SyntaxError for migrated users
Same v2 blob detection gap as folder.service.ts — both need detectBlobVersion before JSON.parse
fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-404 gateway errors, causing detectBlobVersion(undefined) to crash on .length — needed explicit throw on loop exhaustion

Delegated routing API returns CBOR-wrapped records, not raw protobuf — extractCidFromIpnsRecord was parsing incorrectly, returning garbled binary as CID; fix was to use /ipns/{name} gateway path HEAD request instead
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs (duplicate HKDF derivation); also had redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair into rootIpnsKeypair
Desktop vault init wrapped rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB, once for v2 blob; second wrap should reuse first
serialize_vault_blob_v2 needed to return Result<Vec<u8>, VaultBlobError> to enforce key length bounds (prevents silent u16 truncation for keys >65535 bytes)
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, leaking encrypted key material to logs — needed custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields

workflow: When API logs show no activity for an endpoint, query the database directly to verify actual state before assuming failure
GSD execute-phase checkpoint continuation requires spawning a fresh agent with explicit prior state — resume via Task() serialization is unreliable with parallel tool calls
The security:review command can be invoked mid-checkpoint to run a parallel security audit while UAT is paused
MCP Playwright browser session persists across tool calls and can be used to run JS in-page (browser_evaluate) to extract runtime state like private keys for testing
classifyHandoffIfNeeded errors from Claude Code are runtime bugs not agent failures — spot-check SUMMARY.md + commits to determine true completion status

friction: NestJS not logging requests caused significant investigation time — migration appeared silently broken for ~1 hour when it had actually succeeded at 00:12 UTC
Kubo CORS headers missing on API port blocked the simplest IPNS resolution approach; required multiple fallback strategies before landing on gateway /ipns/ HEAD request
Recovery tool IPNS resolution required 6+ iterative fixes: protobuf parsing bug, undefined return, CORS blocks on Kubo, CORS blocks on ipfs.io, API JWT gate, finally gateway HEAD approach
orval codegen bug forced `as unknown as string` casts throughout useAuth.ts — DTO annotation changes have no effect on the generated output
API connection error (ConnectionRefused) interrupted the first security review invocation, requiring a full retry
Working directory mismatch at session start — gsd-tools init was run from cipher-box instead of cipher-box-phase-20, causing phase not found error
Public IPFS DHT did not have IPNS records, making full end-to-end recovery tool testing impossible without local Kubo; subfolder recovery still hangs on resolution
open_items: Recovery tool: private key not zeroed from memory after use (M-1 security finding)
No dedup guard on concurrent vault migration from multiple browser tabs (M-2 security finding)
FUSE vault publish re-wraps rootFolderKey with ECIES on every root folder publish — should cache wrapped key in AppState (M-3 security finding)
Zero-length key accepted by v2 blob deserializers without error (L-1 security finding)
No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html (L-2 security finding)
E2E tests for vault v2 recovery tool — todo created at .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-add-e2e-tests-for-vault-v2-recovery-tool.md
Device registry CryptoError: Invalid registry format — pre-existing schema mismatch in validateDeviceEntry (core/dist/index.mjs:360), todo created
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing, todo created

Subfolder IPNS records not propagated to public DHT — recovery tool traversal works for root folder only; full recursive recovery requires either DHT propagation or an unauthenticated API proxy endpoint
PR #344 review: orval-generated `as unknown as string` casts in useAuth.ts flagged by Copilot but cannot be removed until orval bug is fixed upstream
